set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H00
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Engineering release lead
Scope: One identified artifact satisfies all six core areas and supports the qualified local demonstration.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. All H01-H06 reviews pass and H00.1 binds their compatible evidence to the candidate source/artifact/configuration/fixture identity.
2. The integrated upgrade, workflow, revocation, disk/capacity, backup/recovery and withdrawal rehearsal has no unresolved data-loss or unauthorized-disclosure failure.
3. The release dossier records supported local envelope, known limits, tested recovery failure domain and remaining institutional gates; L01.6 guides reference the same release.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H00/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- H00.1: bd-01M4X8MBBKMP0RS48N087RQ72A

No percent-complete or test-count substitute for integrated evidence. An accepted bounded limit cannot excuse corruption, resurrected authority or false success.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: H00: Accept one integrated core-hardening release
